headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: On consolidated basis, total Op. income for the quarter came in at ₹7,422 crore (up ~20% YoY) amid healthy Royal Enfield sales volume at ~3.8 lakh units (up ~16% YoY).
EBITDA in Q2FY27 came in at ₹1,760 crore with corresponding EBITDA margins at 23.7% (down ~30 bps QoQ).
Resultant PAT for the quarter stood at ₹1,573 crore (up ~15% YoY).
Share of profits from the VECV arm stood at ₹186 crore with EBITDA margins at 7.8%.
valuation: Rating and Target Price • With demand visibility, manufacturing expansion, premiumisation and international opportunities supporting its medium- to long-term business prospects along with a strong growth outlook for VECV arm, we maintain BUY rating on the stock.
ICICI Direct assigns ratings to its stocks according to their notional target price vs. current market price and then categorizes them as Buy, Hold, Reduce and Sell.
The views and opinions expressed in this document may or may not match or may be contrary with the views, estimates, rating, and target price of the Institutional Research.
watch: Investment Rationale: • Structural premiumization trend support demand outlook : Royal Enfield remains well positioned to benefit from the structural premiumisation of the Indian 2W industry.

Rating and Target Price • With demand visibility, manufacturing expansion, premiumisation and international opportunities supporting its medium- to long-term business prospects along with a strong growth outlook for VECV arm, we maintain BUY rating on the stock.
